name: unschool
description: Unschool — trilingual school website with digital product shop

scripts.dev:emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-unschool
scripts.demo: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix site run build:demo && firebase emulators:start --project demo-unschool
scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix site run build
scripts.deploy:hosting: PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://unschool-v2.web.app npm --prefix site run build && firebase deploy --only hosting:site
scripts.check: npm --prefix site run check && npm --prefix functions run check && npm run seo:audit && npm run layout:audit
